description: Replace the data on the persistent volume with a backup. The service stops, the current data is backed up first, the backup is unpacked, and the service starts again. Takes minutes; follow it with runzero_volume_status (`restore.phase` ends at `done`, with `error` if it failed and the data stayed unchanged).

backupId.description: Id of the backup, from runzero_volume_status

name: runzero_restore_volume
title: Restore volume
